transcript:
# WALLINGFORD PENSION COMMISSION

## MINUTES OF REGULAR MEETING OF NOVEMBER 19, 2026

The Wallingford Pension Commission held a meeting on November 19, 2026, in Room 315 of the Town Hall, 45 South Main Street, Wallingford, CT. Commissioners attending: Chair Gary Draghi, Robert Blanchard, William Camelio, James Hutt, William Raddatz and Timothy Sena. Also attending: Brian Naples - Deputy Comptroller, Anthony Tranghese of Wealthspire, Richard Carey of Wealthspire, and Jack Lockwood of Creative Planning. The meeting was called to order at 4:29 pm by Chair Mr. Draghi.

### Agenda Item:

1. Pledge of allegiance was recited.

2. A motion was made by Mr. Camelio seconded by Mr. Blanchard, to accept the minutes of the September 17, 2026, meeting. Motion approved unanimously.

3. Mr. Lockwood reviewed the Town's 457 plan noting that the market value of the plan was $12,271,532.41 for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. It was also noted that 40.74 percent of the funds are within the Nationwide Fixed Accounts.

4. After discussion, no action was taken. MFS Growth R6, JPMorgan Mid Cap Value R6, and Victory Sycamore Small Company Opp R6 all remain on the Quantitative Watch List. Creative Planning will provide possible replacement options for Victory Sycamore Small Company Opp R6 at the next meeting.

5. Wealthspire did an investment review and Municipal landscape update for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, for the Town's Pension Plan. They also reported the plan's market value was $317,186,350 on September 30, 2026, with 35.5% invested in Domestic Equities, 20.2% in International Equities, 32.2% in Fixed Income, 7.6% in Multi-Asset funds and 4.5% in Real Assets. It was noted that the Asset allocation is in line with the Target allocation. The following performance results were reported: quarterly -1.7%, Fiscal YTD -1.7%, YTD 9.1%, 1-year 12.3%, 3-year 15.0%, 5-year 7.1%, 7-year 9.1%, and 10-year 8.7%.

Wealthspire also provided updated balances as of November 18, 2026, noting that the market value of the Town's Pension Plan was $308,639,143.

6. There were no recommendations from Wealthspire to act upon.

7. A motion was made by Mr. Sena, seconded by Mr. Blanchard, to accept the 2027 calendar meeting schedule as presented and noted below: All meetings will take place at 4:30 p.m. in room 315 of the Town Hall, 45 South Main Street, Wallingford, CT.

- Thursday, February 18, 2027
- Thursday, May 13, 2027
- Thursday, September 16, 2027
- Thursday, November 4, 2027

The motion passed unanimously.

8. An update was provided regarding the possible replacement of the recordkeeper for the Town's 457 plan.

9. A motion to adjourn was made by Mr. Camelio, seconded by Mr. Blanchard at 5:35 pm. Motion passed unanimously.

Submitted to the Town Clerk's office on 11/24/2026:

Timothy Sena, Secretary to the Commission
